errors.evidence: The list of countries on the x-axis is incomplete. It omits Ireland (Ирландия), Lithuania (Литва), Poland (Полша), Norway (Норвегия), Montenegro (Монтенегро), and Serbia (Сърбия).
The vertical axis has no text label. It only displays numerical values from 0 to 50. The unit of percentage is implied by the title and context, but it is not an explicit label on the axis.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност е 15%, обслужвана от България и Чехия
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies Bulgaria (България) as having one of the lowest values. In the chart, Bulgaria's value is approximately 34%, which is one of the higher values. The lowest values are for countries like Slovenia (Словения, ~12%) and Denmark (Дания, ~13%).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за Франция, Австрия, Испания и Нидерландия са с приблизително еднаква височина около 30%.
errors.evidence: The statement that the bars for these four countries are of similar height around 30% is incorrect. While Spain's value is approximately 30%, the other countries have significantly lower values: France is ~21%, Austria is ~16%, and the Netherlands is ~15%.
